name: Вихревое рассечение
subject: Small central silver-and-burgundy warrior with right arm extending a silver sword outward. A bright cyan/white circular motion arc rotates AROUND THE CHARACTER at the radius of the sword's OUTER EDGE, interrupted by the leading sword tip. Blade extends radially from hand toward ring; ring centred on torso, never at hilt. Strong spiral spin around body, dark navy. The warrior has uncovered short brown hair and blue eyes, no helmet; silver/brass armor and burgundy cape match the accepted character.
caption: Круговой след проходит вокруг Воина на радиусе режущей части меча.
